a: Limits at infinity describe end behavior of functions.
A function is continuous at a if limit equals f(a).
Differentiability requires the derivative limit to exist.
Related rates differentiate equations linking changing quantities.
Optimization finds maxima/minima often via derivatives.
Implicit differentiation handles equations not solved for y.
Parametric equations define x and y via a parameter t.
Polar coordinates use radius and angle instead of x,y.
A sequence converges if terms approach a finite limit.
Ratio, root, comparison tests help determine series convergence.
